phase: 9 and 10 -- free routing, then direct first-party static policy
routing_doctrine: A sitemap slug NAMES a hotel and never decides one. A slug binds only on a DISTINCTIVE token -- chain words, locality words and directionals are stripped first -- and the chain family must agree. The lex* property-code prefix is Blue Grass Airport's and Marriott applies it to Corbin, Frankfort, Georgetown and Richmond, so a prefix never binds on its own.
